summary: Brookfield Corp and Brookfield Wealth Solutions filed a Form 6-K reporting board approval of a corporate simplification transaction. Under the plan, class A shares of BN and class A exchangeable shares of BWS will be exchanged one-for-one for new shares of Brookfield Corporation Ltd., which will be listed on NYSE and TSX under symbol BN. The transaction will be implemented via a court-approved plan of arrangement requiring shareholder approval at annual meetings on July 16, 2026. Completion is expected by year-end, subject to regulatory approvals and customary conditions. The simplified structure creates a single publicly traded entity combining both firms.
